blocks.text: Daniel 12 contains 13 verses. It opens with: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince who standeth for the children of thy people; and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book. It concludes with: But go thou thy way till the end be; for thou shalt rest, and shalt stand in thy lot, at the end of the days.
